{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Dagger}}
[[File:TwilekDagger-TVD.jpg|thumb|right|100px|A Twi'lek dagger]]
{{Quote|A dagger is always ready when you need it. It has no gas cartridge or power cell to drain.|Unidentified individual|<ref name="Threat of the Conqueror">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Razor Slash}}</ref>}}
The '''dagger''' was a simple [[Knife/Legends|knife]]-like [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] that was still in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was usually a side arm.

==History==
Daggers were used or carried by a variety of individuals, such as [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]],<ref name="Boba Fett: Maze of Deception">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref> [[Durge/Legends|Durge]],<ref name="Boba Fett: Hunted">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]],<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref> [[Jax Pavan]],<ref name="Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> [[Dusque Mistflier]],<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]],<ref name="Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080522/index.html|text="Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array"|int=Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> [[Oola/Legends|Oola]],<ref name="Oola's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Time to Mourn, a Time to Dance: Oola's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> and [[Tenel Ka Djo]].<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>

Daggers were used in conjunction with [[blastsword]]s in blastsword duels, such as the one between [[Depird ke Fanax]] and [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]]. The blastsword would be held in one hand, while the dagger was held in the off-hand.<ref name="X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
